purpose: Source-of-truth tracker for the 6 runs (3 variants × 2 sets) feeding the vision-check phase-1 metrics. Each entry pins the run identifiers, submission, tooling, artifacts, and known issues so the per-variant TSV builds and analysis.md stay traceable.
canonicalStorage: Artifacts for each active source run live at source-runs/<set>/<variant>/. When a run is replaced, the prior artifacts are wiped and replaced — only the supersedes block here records what came before. See source-runs/README.md.

successCriteria.A: var2 overall vision invocation hit rate >= var1's, on items where TSV 1 expects vision
successCriteria.B: var2 specialist selection rate >= var1's, on items expected to use a specialist

variants.ctrl-baseline: Generic vision tool only (production prompt, no experiment overlay).
variants.var1-bifurcated-vision-tools: Generic vision + direct specialist (inspect-drawing for cc, measure-distance for review). Agent picks.
variants.var2-vision-specialist-routing: vision_check only (semantic-search-blocks also exposed). Internal classifier dispatches to generic / specialist.

statusValues.current: Run is done, TSV is built, data is canonical for this cell.
statusValues.needs-rerun: Run is done but has a known confounder (e.g. runs=1 vs runs=3) that should be retired before the headline number is final. Current TSV is usable as a placeholder.
statusValues.needs-tsv-build: Run is done; TSV not yet built into the metrics/ tree.
statusValues.missing-ids: Run was fired but the canonical IDs (workflow_runs.id, etc.) aren't recorded in this tracker yet — Supabase lookup pending.

notes: Production prompt (no experiment overlay).

Vision tool prompt-traceability gap: vision-log.jsonl only records {event, documentId, sheetNum, success, timestamp} — no prompt or item attribution. Item attribution comes via per-finding tools_used.

tools_used does NOT track inspect-drawing entries (known agent SDK / build-review-comments bug). Workaround: read inspect-drawing-calls/<callId>/metadata.json directly for inspect-drawing attribution.
Sparse specialist usage: 3 inspect-drawing calls total, all in run-1, on AW-21 + AW-23.
On AW-23/run-1, inspect-drawing returned classification=yes (flow arrows present) but the agent's finding contradicted it using vision and finalized status=fail. Tool-integration fragility flagged.

buckets.rerunReason: runs=1 vs ctrl/var1 runs=3. Strict-majority threshold is more demanding at runs=3 — re-fire at runs=3 to retire the confounder before the headline Goal A comparison is final.
notes: Source of truth for var2 attribution is vision-check-calls/<callId>/metadata.json (precise per-call dispatch detail).
115 total vision_check calls across the run; 63 unique items invoked; 35 items routed to generic, 28 to inspect-drawing.
1 measurement-routed call fell back to generic via measurement_arg_construction_not_implemented (measurement dispatch deferred at conductor level).
No misuse: 0 calls on no-tool items.
Re-fire of the el-md-exp ctrl baseline on Valley View v1 (was on v2 in V2/V1) — chosen to match var1's experiment-run7.2 submission.

First baseline run that uses the new review-extended.md prompt path (reviewPromptName='review-extended', reviewSchemaName='reviewExtended'). Each finding should now carry agentTrace.{observation, reasoning, tools_used} for ALL statuses (pass / fail / not-verifiable / n/a) — closes the per-item tool-attribution gap that blocked Goal A on review.
Workflow_runs.id and review id need Supabase lookup once Substation creates the DB record.

Supersedes BASELINE (workflow_runs.id 300eb8a1-9bb1-4257-a88a-745bf696b805, on Valley View v2) and BASELINE_V2 (review id 224279d8-4827-44cd-a15b-1f034496dac2, on Valley View v2 — silently failed agentTrace).

Re-fire of var1 post bureau#317. The measure-distance overlay's review.md now has the {{ agentTraceGuidance }} placeholder, so logAllAgentTrace=true properly appends the emit-all-statuses override. Coverage closed: 303/303 (item × run) cells now have findings (was 201/303 in VAR1_RUN_1).
Goal A jumped from lower-bound 60.8% to definitive 74.5% (+13.7pp). Var1's bifurcated agent invokes vision freely on most items.

Goal B unchanged at 0/51 — agent still never invokes measure-distance directly. Same sparse-adoption pattern as cc var1's inspect-drawing (2/162). The signal isn't going to change without architectural intervention.

Tools_used distribution: vision (208 occurrences), Read (12), mcp__conductor_tools__vision (4). Zero measure-distance entries — the agent's Read/Glob/Bash use is normal but it ignores the specialist tool entirely.

supersedes.reason: Partial coverage (201/303 cells) — measure-distance overlay's review.md was missing the {{ agentTraceGuidance }} placeholder.

notes: Local conductor execution (--step=review-runs --runs=3). First var-2 run after bureau#340 prompt tweak ('dimensional analysis, distance computation' added to the vision_check capability list in the experiment overlay's review.md).
86 vision_check calls total (run-1: 28, run-2: 31, run-3: 27). Up from RUN_9's 67 — agent is broadly more aggressive about measurement invocation.
**Goal A** (strict-majority invocation on expected=yes): 11/54 = 20.4%. On expected=no: 42/47 = 89.4% correctly skipped.

**Goal B raw**: 11/54 = 20.4%. **Adjusted** (drop 17 valid-skip rows): 11/37 = 29.7%. **Strict-clear** (also drop 10 mixed): **11/27 = 40.7%** — headline going forward, since this denominator most accurately captures the bucket of data var-2 is trying to address.
**Goal C** (subprocess success on dispatched measure-distance): runs at 100% as in RUN_9.

**Verdict-conversion**: 10 of the 11 measurement-majority items had ctrl maj `not-verifiable`. 3 moved to a real-verdict majority in RUN_10 (EL-13.1 → fail, EL-13.16 → n/a, EL-13.21 → pass). 2 broke nv-majority to a 3-way-tie. 5 stayed maj nv. The most dramatic case: EL-13.21 ctrl unanimous nv → RUN_10 maj pass.
See [`var2-uplift.md`](var2-uplift.md) for the dedicated story of the 11 items.

B_strict_clear_misses_only.method: Drop 17 valid skips AND 10 mixed (runs disagreed materially).

goals.D_post_result_verdict: 3/10 measurement-routed nv-majority items moved to a real-verdict majority. Iter-2 territory.

Same submission, model, runs=3, and specialists. Goal B variants lifted across the board: raw 9.3% → 20.4%, adjusted 15.2% → 29.7%, strict-clear 29.4% → 40.7%.
